title: Intent coverage
instructions:
The issue is the specification. Measure the diff against it in both directions: every unit against the claims it implements, and every claim against the units that implement it. Deciding that mapping is the whole of this lens; whether the code is right belongs to another one.

A unit you can attach to no claim is not evidence of a defect. The likeliest cause is intent the author never wrote down, so it goes to them as a question, and a note that already explains the unit settles it with no item at all. Report what you could not establish instead of resolving it yourself.
focus: Which claim does this unit implement, and what in the issue text says so?
If no claim covers it, is this intent that never reached the tracker?
Does a note already explain why this unit is here?
Which claim is implemented nowhere in the diff?
